outcome: large for gestational age (neonatal weight >90th customized GROW percentile or Hadlock fetal weight >90th percentile)
cohort: The study included 26,527 pregnancies that had an antenatal ultrasound-estimated fetal weight between 35+0 and 38+0 weeks gestation for any indication.
finding: Late third-trimester ultrasound estimation of fetal weight for any indication effectively predicts large for gestational age at birth, with improved performance when using a customized standard.
birth_weight: LGA defined as >90th customized GROW percentile; Macrosomia defined as >4 kg
gest_age: Antenatal ultrasound between 35+0 and 38+0 weeks gestation; Delivery at median 39+3 weeks gestation (IQR 15 days)
